{"id":1815455805,"question_id":4078,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1761775986,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"113 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1815455805/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Alternating Sum of Squares","memory":"194.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maxAlternatingSum(vector<int>& nums) {\n        priority_queue<int , vector<int> , greater<int>>pq;\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unsigned long long sq_sum = 0;\n        long long minuses = n/2;\n\n        for(auto it : nums) \n        {\n            pq.push(it*it);\n            sq_sum += (unsigned long long)it*it;\n        }\n\n        while(!pq.empty() && minuses>0)\n        {\n            int top = pq.top(); pq.pop();\n            sq_sum -= 2ULL*top;\n            minuses--;\n        }\n        return sq_sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-alternating-sum-of-squares","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1013}
